note: This is an internal candidate/QA stage contract. It does not activate ontology v0.2 or wall handoff.

gates.control: required-fields, finite values, version, allowed class and QA-state are valid
box has positive area, is within source-page bounds, and coordinate_space is explicit source-page

visible drawing evidence supports the proposed class; beam must not be joist/truss/grid/dimension/note, column must not be mere text/grid/symbol without a column instance, wall must have reliable structural semantics
box is tight around the visible target instance; does not include unrelated text/dimensions/grids and does not infer hidden continuation
ambiguous-class, ambiguous-presence or overlap-ambiguous blocks promotion; no-safe-bbox is not a negative label
no duplicate instance and no exact/near-duplicate leakage across project-group train/validation/test splits
stable candidate ID, source/page/project-group, candidate generator version, evidence/reason and review state are preserved; human QA is required when the annotation spec requires it
